senses.gloss:
a. 
(-वी f.) [शिवो देवताऽस्य अण्] Relating to the god Śiva. 
-वः 
__1 N. of one of the three principal Hindu sects. 
__2 A member of the Śaiva sect. 
__3 The thorn-apple. 
-वम् N. of one of the eighteen Purāṇas, of a Śāstra or Tantra.

[शी-वलच् [[Uṇ. 4. 38]]] A kind of aquatic plant, moss; सरसिजमनुविद्धं शैवलेनापि रम्यम् [[Ś. 1. 20]]; न षट्पदश्रेणिभिःरेव पङ्कजं सशैवलासंगमपि प्रकाशते [[Ku. 5. 9.]] 
-लम् A kind of fragrant wood.

__1 N. of one of the four horses of Kṛṣṇa. 
__2 N. of a king and warrior in the Pāṇḍava army. 
__3 A horse (in general).
